ceiling_directive: Supply a machine-checkable exact certificate for the uniform shifted-support Hellinger inequality, including the moving-boundary terms, so that the all-test converse and matched fourth-root rate are genuinely established.
improvement_directive: Replace the undisplayed rational-function cancellation behind equation (5) with an explicit symbolic or SOS certificate and rerun Theorem 4 from that verified lemma. Provide the corresponding machine-readable quantifier-elimination certificates if the exact K3 and C4 constants are retained.
critique: The advertised matched all-test r^{-1/4} frontier is not fully proved: Lemma 2 reduces its load-bearing uniform shifted-support bound to an undisplayed cancellation and an assertion that unspecified polynomial coefficients are nonnegative. The exact K3 and C4 values likewise rest on a narrative CAD procedure and a claimed terminal sign table rather than supplied, independently checkable certificates. What is securely delivered is unbiased quadratic estimation, attainment and duality of the finite variance game, calibration by exhaustive semialgebraic enumeration in principle, and an upper detection rate for disjoint repeated motifs—not the claimed matched minimax frontier. The restrictive repeated-motif model and absence of executable calibration or certificate evidence further constrain the leading-journal score.
